name: ykkC guanidine riboswitch (D. dadantii) bound to guanidinium
source: RCSB PDB 5U3G; Sherwood AV & Breaker RR RNA 2017 doi:10.1261/rna.062802.117
notes: ykkC guanidine riboswitch from Dickeya dadantii. Ligand GAI at B:125. 2.30A X-ray. 3rd distinct guanidine fold (after 5T83 Guanidine-I and 5NZ6 Guanidine-III).
